technical.summary: CTSH shows long-term uptrend structure but is caught in a sharp short-term downtrend with oversold oscillators, negative momentum, and capitulation volume—lacks confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: CTSH shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 12 days present elevated volatility risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (31 Fear & Greed score) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is stale (6+ months old) with no recent conviction signals.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (371.2) dominates risk landscape; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 12 days adds binary event risk; macro score of -1 confirms hostile environment for equities.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term EMA/SMA structure remains bullish (50/200 crossover), extreme fear (31 F&G) offers contrarian opportunity, and price near support (79.29) provides defined risk entry with 2:1 reward potential to resistance (81.10).
debate.key_bear_argument: Capitulation volume (15x spike), active death cross (EMA 9/21), negative momentum (MACD, CMF), oversold oscillators without bullish confirmation, zero institutional/insider conviction, earnings binary event in 12 days, and VIX crisis regime (371.2) create hostile conditions that overwhelm technical structure.

decision.entry_rationale: While price sits at support (79.29) with long-term EMA/SMA bullish structure and extreme fear presents contrarian opportunity, the confluence of capitulation volume (15x spike), active death cross, negative momentum, zero institutional conviction, and VIX crisis regime (371.2) creates asymmetric downside risk that outweighs the technical setup.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 12 days combined with VIX crisis regime and active short-term downtrend could trigger further capitulation below support, invalidating the swing thesis.
